sentences.text: 2  WP No. 1979 of 2026 HC-

KAR  THIS WRIT PETITION IS FILED UNDER ARTICLES 226 AND 227 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA PRAYING TO DIRECT THE R1 TO RECEIVE THE PUC MARKS CARD AND REGULARIZE THE ADMISSION OF THE PETITIONERS IN THE R2 COLLEGE.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ASHOK S.KINAGI  ORAL ORDER Heard the arguments of learned counsel for the petitioners and learned HCGP for respondent No.1.
2.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that, pursuant to the interim order dated 23.01.2026,
the petitioners have paid the examination fees.
He seeks for a direction to respondent No.2 to accept the PUC marks cards of the petitioners.

3. Learned HCGP submits that, if the petitioners submit their original marks cards to respondent No.2, the respondents will consider them by permitting the petitioners to appear for the examination scheduled to commence from 11.02.2026.
NC: 2026:KHC:6700 HC-KAR 4.
In view of the submission made by the learned HCGP, nothing further survives for consideration in this writ petition.
5. Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of directing respondent No.2 to forward the original PUC marks cards of the petitioners to respondent No.1 within 1 week from today.
6. Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.

Sd/-
